name: Pico Two-Task Smoke Test
description: Hardware smoke test for a Raspberry Pi Pico: two cyclic tasks, FastCounter (10 ms) and SlowBlink (100 ms), which blinks an LED on GP0 (%Q0.0) every 500 ms. By hand, power-cycling the board and seeing the LED blink again shows the firmware restoring the saved program; no variable is retained, because the compiler does not support source RETAIN yet, so retained data cannot be taught here. It has no scenario: the test engine runs one task per project.
author: ZPLC Team

outputs.name: LED
outputs.description: GP0 (led0 in the Pico overlay): wire an LED with a series resistor to GND. Blinks every 500 ms.
